claims.disproof_condition: 條件：之後四季以上的公開提單紀錄不再出現華明對 Georgia Transformer／Virginia Transformer 的出貨，或 Virginia Transformer 一手寫出不再向華明採購。核查頻率：每季（ImportYeti／ImportGenius 公開頁，互動 session 人工查）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 加註或降 confidence，重讀分接開關層「美國這段的缺貨流向誰」。
claims.statement: U.S. customs bill-of-lading record (aggregated by ImportGenius; supplier page under the older name Shanghai Huaming Power): bill of lading UULNSH24041007, product 'ON LOAD TAP CHANGER', importer GEORGIA TRANSFORMER CORPORATION, supplier SHANGHAI HUAMING POWER, arrived 2024-06-06, 3,262 kg, 11 packages. Georgia Transformer (GTC) is Virginia Transformer's manufacturing facility in Rincon, Georgia (Virginia Transformer press release, 2026-04-22). Regulatory record, independent of Huaming's own statements. Third-party aggregators list 4 shipments to this consignee (2024-06, 2024-08, 2024-10, 2026-04, the last described as 'Tap Changer' by ImportYeti); Virginia Transformer's main tap-changer source on the same aggregator is Maschinenfabrik Reinhausen, so Huaming is an occasional second source here.
